patches.text: Upon selecting a date, search for available appointments with general medicine providers.
patches.rationale: To ensure that patients have access to general medicine providers on their preferred date.
patches.evidence:
Conversation excerpt: PATIENT: I need to cancel my appointment on Wednesday.
ASSISTANT: I'll help you cancel your appointment. First, I need to verify your identity before proceeding with any changes.

patches.text: Search for available appointments with general medicine providers on the selected date.
patches.rationale: To make it clear what the tool does and to improve user experience.
patches.evidence:
Conversation excerpt: PATIENT: I’m hoping for Thursday, October 15th if possible, any time works really well.
